reference_model: abstract charge-frozen square-torus stabilizer parent; each edge is a one-particle rung qubit

commuting_parent_terms.star: Q_s=(prod_(e in star s) P_e - prod_(e in star s) X_e)/2
commuting_parent_terms.plaquette: Q_p=(prod_(e in boundary p) P_e - prod_(e in boundary p) Z_e)/2
commuting_parent_terms.hamiltonian: H=U sum_e C_e + J_s sum_s Q_s + J_p sum_p Q_p

exact_symmetries: global rail parities P_a and P_b

decision: The exact 2D reference has the expected commuting stabilizer algebra, four torus ground states, and no non-scalar projected Pauli on fewer than three physical edges.  This is a reference-control result only; it is not a native ANTLER Hamiltonian.
mandatory_next_gate: Derive, from explicitly specified ANTLER local degrees of freedom and mediator couplings, a low-body Hamiltonian whose controlled low-energy theory produces these four-rung star and plaquette terms. Until that Schrieffer-Wolff/error analysis passes, the parent is imposed rather than emergent.
claim_boundary: This establishes neither a microscopic mediator realization, a dynamical exchange protocol, anyon braiding, non-Abelian statistics, universality, nor fault tolerance.  The reference stabilizer code is Abelian.
